```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)

## ---- Inputs --------------------------------------------
phage_csv <- here("data", "results_with_metadata.csv")

## ---- Output directory ----------------------------------
out_dir <- here("results", "phage_lifestyle_weighted")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

## ---- 1) Load data --------------------------------------
df <- read_csv(phage_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Checks mínimos
stopifnot(all(c("vOTUs","Host.genus","CPM","Virulent","Temperate") %in% names(df)))

df2 <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Host.genus), !is.na(CPM), CPM >= 0) %>%
  mutate(
    Virulent = as.numeric(Virulent),
    Temperate = as.numeric(Temperate)
  )

## ---- 2) CPM-weighted lifestyle per genus ----------------
lifestyle_by_genus <- df2 %>%
  group_by(Host.genus) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_vOTUs = n_distinct(vOTUs),
    CPM_sum = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE),

    # Unweighted (como Table S4E, aprox)
    virulent_mean = mean(Virulent, na.rm = TRUE),
    temperate_mean = mean(Temperate, na.rm = TRUE),

    # Weighted by abundance
    virulent_CPMweighted = sum(CPM * Virulent, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    temperate_CPMweighted = sum(CPM * Temperate, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(virulent_CPMweighted))

write.csv(lifestyle_by_genus,
          file = file.path(out_dir, "lifestyle_by_genus_CPMweighted.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

## ---- 3) Focus on Gemmiger -------------------------------
gemmiger_summary <- lifestyle_by_genus %>%
  filter(Host.genus == "Gemmiger")

write.csv(gemmiger_summary,
          file = file.path(out_dir, "gemmiger_lifestyle_CPMweighted.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

## ---- 4) Top vOTUs in Gemmiger ---------------------------
gemmiger_top20 <- df2 %>%
  filter(Host.genus == "Gemmiger") %>%
  group_by(vOTUs) %>%
  summarise(
    CPM = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    Virulent = mean(Virulent, na.rm = TRUE),
    Temperate = mean(Temperate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(CPM)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

write.csv(gemmiger_top20,
          file = file.path(out_dir, "gemmiger_top20_vOTUs_by_CPM.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

## ---- 5) Optional figure: mean vs CPM-weighted -----------

# ejemplo: solo top 10 host genera por CPM_sum (para no hacer una figura interminable)
top_genera <- lifestyle_by_genus %>%
  arrange(desc(CPM_sum)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(Host.genus = factor(Host.genus, levels = Host.genus))

p <- ggplot(top_genera, aes(x = Host.genus)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = virulent_mean), position = position_nudge(x = -0.15)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = virulent_CPMweighted), position = position_nudge(x = 0.15)) +
  labs(
    x = "Host genus",
    y = "Virulent probability",
    title = "Predicted lifestyle by host genus (mean vs CPM-weighted)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(filename = file.path(out_dir, "virulent_mean_vs_CPMweighted_top10genera.pdf"),
       plot = p, width = 7, height = 4)

saveRDS(
  list(
    lifestyle_by_genus = lifestyle_by_genus,
    gemmiger_summary = gemmiger_summary,
    gemmiger_top20 = gemmiger_top20
  ),
  file = file.path(out_dir, "lifestyle_weighted_results.rds")
)

```


```{r}
library(tidyr)

plot_df <- top_genera %>%
  select(Host_genus_short, virulent_mean, virulent_CPMweighted) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(virulent_mean, virulent_CPMweighted),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  )

p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Host_genus_short, y = value, color = metric)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.3), size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Host genus",
    y = "Virulent probability",
    color = "",
    title = "Predicted lifestyle by host genus"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("virulent_mean" = "black",
               "virulent_CPMweighted" = "red"),
    labels = c("Mean per vOTU", "CPM-weighted")
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
print(p)
```



```{r}
## =========================================================
## Phage lifestyle (mean vs CPM-weighted) + top vOTUs (Gemmiger)
## Coherent colors (same palette) + genus labels after g__
## =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
  library(here)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
})

## ---- Inputs --------------------------------------------
phage_csv <- here("data", "results_with_metadata.csv")

## ---- Output directory ----------------------------------
out_dir <- here("results", "phage_lifestyle_weighted")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

## ---- Palette of colors ---------------------------------
custom_colors <- c(
  "Streptococcus"    = "pink",
  "Bacteroides"      = "mediumaquamarine",
  "Escherichia"      = "gold",
  "Faecalibacterium" = "#C499CC",
  "Bifidobacterium"  = "#6FA3F7",
  "Klebsiella"       = "#7B2CBF",
  "Blautia"          = "#90DDF0",
  "Gemmiger"         = "#FFAC81",
  "Ruminococcus"     = "#FA6459",
  "Pseudomonas"      = "#EEE2DF",
  "Veillonella"      = "darkgreen"
)

ensure_palette <- function(levels_vec, pal){
  miss <- setdiff(levels_vec, names(pal))
  if(length(miss) > 0){
    pal <- c(pal, setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(miss)), miss))
  }
  pal
}

## ---- Helpers -------------------------------------------
extract_clean_phage_genus <- function(x){
  # keeps only what goes after g__ (up to ; if present)
  g <- ifelse(!is.na(x) & str_detect(x, "g__"),
              str_extract(x, "(?<=g__)[^;]+"),
              as.character(x))
  g <- str_replace(g, "_[A-Z]$", "")
  g <- str_trim(g)
  dplyr::recode(g,
                "Kleibsella" = "Klebsiella",
                "Gemminger"  = "Gemmiger",
                .default = g)
}

## ---- 1) Load data --------------------------------------
df <- read_csv(phage_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

stopifnot(all(c("vOTUs","Host.genus","CPM","Virulent","Temperate") %in% names(df)))

df2 <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Host.genus), !is.na(CPM), CPM > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    Host_genus_short = extract_clean_phage_genus(Host.genus),
    Virulent  = as.numeric(Virulent),
    Temperate = as.numeric(Temperate)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Host_genus_short), Host_genus_short != "",
         !is.na(Virulent), !is.na(Temperate))

# Convert 0-100 -> 0-1 if needed
if (max(df2$Virulent, na.rm = TRUE) > 1.5 || max(df2$Temperate, na.rm = TRUE) > 1.5) {
  df2 <- df2 %>% mutate(Virulent = Virulent/100, Temperate = Temperate/100)
}

## ---- 2) Lifestyle per genus (mean vs CPM-weighted) ------
lifestyle_by_genus <- df2 %>%
  group_by(Host_genus_short) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows  = n(),
    n_vOTUs = n_distinct(vOTUs),
    CPM_sum = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE),

    virulent_mean   = mean(Virulent, na.rm = TRUE),
    temperate_mean  = mean(Temperate, na.rm = TRUE),

    virulent_CPMweighted  = sum(CPM * Virulent, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    temperate_CPMweighted = sum(CPM * Temperate, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(CPM_sum))

write.csv(lifestyle_by_genus,
          file = file.path(out_dir, "lifestyle_by_genus_mean_vs_CPMweighted.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

## ---- 3) Plot: top 10 genera by CPM_sum ------------------
top_genera <- lifestyle_by_genus %>%
  arrange(desc(CPM_sum)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(
    Host_genus_short = factor(Host_genus_short, levels = Host_genus_short)
  )

top_genera <- top_genera %>%
  arrange(desc(virulent_CPMweighted)) %>%   # orden visual
  mutate(
    Host_genus_short = factor(Host_genus_short, levels = Host_genus_short)
  )

pal_top <- ensure_palette(levels(top_genera$Host_genus_short), custom_colors)

p_top10_vir <- ggplot(top_genera, aes(x = Host_genus_short, color = Host_genus_short)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = Host_genus_short, y = virulent_mean, yend = virulent_CPMweighted),
    color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(y = virulent_mean), size = 2.4, shape = 16) +      # mean
  geom_point(aes(y = virulent_CPMweighted), size = 2.6, shape = 17) + # CPM-weighted
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_top, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Virulent probability",
    title = "Predicted lifestyle by host genus (top 10 by CPM)",
    subtitle = "Circle = mean per vOTU; triangle = CPM-weighted (abundance-weighted)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_top10_temp <- ggplot(top_genera, aes(x = Host_genus_short, color = Host_genus_short)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = Host_genus_short, y = temperate_mean, yend = temperate_CPMweighted),
    color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(y = temperate_mean), size = 2.4, shape = 16) +
  geom_point(aes(y = temperate_CPMweighted), size = 2.6, shape = 17) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_top, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Temperate probability",
    title = "Predicted lifestyle by host genus (top 10 by CPM)",
    subtitle = "Circle = mean per vOTU; triangle = CPM-weighted (abundance-weighted)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "top10_genus_virulent_mean_vs_CPMweighted.png"),
       p_top10_vir, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "top10_genus_temperate_mean_vs_CPMweighted.png"),
       p_top10_temp, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "top10_genus_virulent_mean_vs_CPMweighted.pdf"),
       p_top10_vir, width = 11, height = 7, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "top10_genus_temperate_mean_vs_CPMweighted.pdf"),
       p_top10_temp, width = 11, height = 7, bg = "white")

print(p_top10_vir)
print(p_top10_temp)

## ---- 4) Gemmiger: top 20 vOTUs by CPM -------------------
gemmiger_top20 <- df2 %>%
  filter(Host_genus_short == "Gemmiger") %>%
  group_by(vOTUs) %>%
  summarise(
    CPM = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    Virulent = sum(CPM * Virulent, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    Temperate = sum(CPM * Temperate, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(CPM)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

write.csv(gemmiger_top20,
          file = file.path(out_dir, "gemmiger_top20_vOTUs_by_CPM.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Optional quick print
print(gemmiger_top20)

```
